May 1, 2017

The Braves wrapped up the Winter 2016/17 season this weekend winning the consolation finals on back to back defaults by the opposition. Congratulations goes out to this year's award winners:

 

#3 - Marco Congiusti

Most Improved

#7 - Stephen Keane

Rookie of the Year

#13 - Cameron Buchanan

Bill Masterton Award for Dedication

#44 - Alex Pagnotta

James Norris Award

#87 - Michael Congiusti

Lady Byng Award for Sportsmanship

#94 - Ben Sherritt

Maurice "Rocket" Richard Award
Season MVP
Conn Smyth Award Playoff MVP

The Braves would like to welcome new additions, defensemen Michael Grande and Lorcan Duffy to the team for the Summer 2017 season. Also, scrappy centreman Anthony Paolucci will rejoin the squad along with defenseman Andrew Buchanan.
